_note: Restated consolidated figures read from the filed document and cited by printed page. Amounts in Indian Rupees millions unless stated. The three months ended June 30, 2025 is a stub period: its return on capital employed is reported by the issuer on an unannualised basis and is therefore not comparable to a full year, which is why the indexed exhibit uses full fiscal years only.

periodsSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Basis for Offer Price, key performance indicators, printed page 142; capacity by data centre, printed pages 49 and 301; return on capital employed, printed page 287

costStackSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, notes 23 to 26 forming part of the restated consolidated financial information, printed page 398. Borrowing costs are capitalised at 9.30% per annum, stated in the footnote to note 25.

basisSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, restated financial information. The statements are titled Restated Consolidated throughout, and the column header printed above them reads Consolidated for the two most recent periods and Standalone for the two older ones. The auditor's examination report says the same in words. The associate is SKVR Software Solution Private Limited, and its share of profit is printed on the restated statement of profit and loss

balanceSheetSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Restated Consolidated Statement of Assets and Liabilities. Net worth is equity share capital plus other equity. Borrowings are the non current and current borrowing lines added. Lease liabilities are the non current and current lease lines added, held apart from borrowings because which of the two belongs inside total borrowings is the question the printed formula leaves open. Cash is the cash and bank balances line, excluding other bank balances.

roceFormulaSource.label: The formula is printed inside the commissioned 1Lattice and Cushman and Wakefield industry report rather than beside the figures the issuer claims for itself: return on capital employed is EBIT over average capital employed, EBIT is EBITDA less depreciation and amortisation, and capital employed is net worth plus total borrowings less cash and cash equivalents.

cashFlowSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Restated Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow. Capital expenditure is the purchase of property, plant and equipment line. Amounts paid to acquire right of use assets are reported separately in the same statement and are held separately here. Tax paid and capital expenditure are outflows in the filing and are recorded as positive magnitudes.

contractsSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Risk Factor 17, share of total revenue on contract terms of at least 7 years with 5 years of average contract life remaining, printed page 46

sitesSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, capacity and capacity utilization by data center as at and for the three months ended June 30, 2025, certified by the Independent Chartered Engineer. The same table is printed twice, at printed page 49 under Risk Factor 21 and again at printed page 301 in Our Business, with identical figures.

peersSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, comparison of the key performance indicators of our Company with listed industry peers, printed page 144. Figures are as the issuer presents them, in Indian Rupees millions. Cells the issuer marked not applicable are carried as nulls rather than filled, because the gap is itself the finding.

clientsSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, revenue from operations attributable to the top 10 clients, printed page 36. Client names are withheld in the filing itself for confidentiality and lack of consent, and the issuer notes the top 10 may not be the same clients in each period. Clients 1, 2 and 3 are Hyperscalers in every period.

majorCustomerSource.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, note 33 to the Restated Consolidated financial information, segment reporting, under the heading Major Customer. The note aggregates three customers and gives the amount only. It is the one statement of this concentration inside the accounts the auditor examined.

engineeredToSupport.quote: Built Capacity is the maximum IT load a data center is engineered to support, based on business requirements, space planning, and infrastructure feasibility.

availableToSell.quote: Total available power capacity that can be sold to customers during the year/period.

governance._note: The legal section, read for the one thing a reader cannot get from the narrative: how large a matter has to be before this issuer is obliged to tell anyone about it, and how the matters it does disclose reached it. The threshold is not printed as a number anywhere. It is printed as a formula whose three inputs are in the financial statements, so the figure is derived at render from the issuer's own numbers rather than typed here.

tests.label: 5 per cent of average absolute profit after tax, last three years

materiality.carveOut: The net worth test is disapplied where the arithmetic value of net worth is negative.

risks.gradingNote: Severity and likelihood are analyst gradings. The magnitude beside each row is not: where a row is marked measured, the figure is derived at render from the filed numbers recorded for this name and moves if they move. The prospectus publishes no risk grading of its own, so nothing here is the issuer's ranking of its own risk factors.
risks.unevidencedNote: One of the six pillars still carries no row. Valuation needs a price band and the draft document carries none, which is a property of a draft red herring prospectus rather than a gap that reading harder would close. Governance was empty until the outstanding litigation at printed 463 was read, and the row it carries now is what that section says about itself rather than about any single matter. The auditor's report and the related party notes inside the restated financial information are still not cited, so the governance pillar is opened rather than finished.

rows.risk: Several proceedings disclosed in the legal section reached the issuer through public databases rather than through service, and the largest class of them cannot be quantified at all.
rows.mitigant: The issuer discloses both the fact and the method in its own words and names the database in each case, which is more than the policy on materiality obliges it to say.
rows.note: The magnitude is the count of proceedings the document itself describes as unserved. This is an observation about how information reaches the issuer rather than a view on the merits of any matter, and the twenty tax appeals carry no amount, so the largest number in the section is not necessarily the largest exposure in it.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Section VI, outstanding litigation and material developments

rows.risk: Power is the cost base rather than a line inside it, so a tariff move lands on the margin almost undiluted.
rows.mitigant: Some contracts pass power through to the customer. The filing does not state what share of revenue is covered that way, so the protection cannot be sized from what has been read.
rows.note: Drawn against revenue rather than against total cost, because revenue is the denominator the contractual escalator applies to.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, notes 23 to 26 forming part of the restated consolidated financial information, printed page 398

rows.risk: Two fifths of built capacity earns nothing while still carrying depreciation, interest and the ground it stands on.
rows.mitigant: Most of the gap sits in two recently commissioned towers, so part of it is a fill rate that has not had time rather than one that has failed.
rows.note: The same table is printed twice, at printed 49 under a risk factor and again at printed 301 in the business section, with identical figures.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, capacity and capacity utilization by data center, certified by the Independent Chartered Engineer, printed page 301

rows.risk: The estate was built with money the business did not generate, in every filed period but one.
rows.mitigant: The gap is disclosed in the issuer's own statement of cash flow rather than reconstructed from other figures, and the offer exists to fund the next stage of it.
rows.note: Capital expenditure leads commissioning by years, so the one covered period is a gap in the spending trail rather than a change in how the build is funded. The quarter after it is back to spending more than it earns.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Restated Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow, printed page 355

rows.risk: Three counterparties are two thirds of the revenue, and the largest of them alone is close to half.
rows.mitigant: The same three sit on contracts of at least seven years with roughly five years of average life remaining, so the revenue is contracted rather than held at will.
rows.note: Clients are unnamed in the filing, and the issuer states the top ten may not be the same clients in each period. This is therefore concentration by rank rather than by counterparty.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, revenue from operations attributable to the top 10 clients, printed page 36

rows.risk: Contracts escalate 2 to 4 per cent a year with limited rights to reprice mid term, against a cost base that is mostly power.
rows.mitigant: Tenure cuts both ways. The terms that cap the upside also secure the base through a build phase, which is when an estate is least able to replace a customer.
rows.note: The share on long contracts is the same figure, to the second decimal, as the top three clients in every period. The document reports the two in different sections and never joins them.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Risk Factor 17, revenue on contract terms of at least 7 years, printed page 46

rows.risk: Borrowing cost is capitalised into assets under construction rather than expensed, and that stops the moment a tower commissions.
rows.mitigant: Both the amount and the rate are disclosed in the note, so a reader can size the unwind in advance rather than meet it in a later income statement.
rows.note: Commissioning moves the same money twice: interest returns to the income statement, and depreciation begins on the asset it was capitalised into.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, note 25 and the footnote stating the capitalisation rate, printed page 398

rows.risk: Net debt runs close to four times EBITDA while the estate is still filling.
rows.mitigant: The ratio is the issuer's own and is disclosed for every period in the key performance indicators, so the trend is visible rather than inferred.
rows.note: Read from the stub quarter, the most recent period the filing reports. The ratio there rests on an unannualised EBITDA and is not comparable to a full year.

source.label: Sify Infinit Spaces DRHP, Basis for Offer Price, key performance indicators, printed page 142

rows.risk: The headline capacity figure is defined two ways inside one document, so the same number reads as engineered or as sellable depending on the page.
rows.mitigant: Both definitions are printed and both are carried here. The site draws the rungs separately rather than carrying a single capacity number.
rows.note: Not measured, and marked as such. The risk is a definition rather than a magnitude, so this row is judgement and the exhibit draws it outlined.
